items.title: UAE holding structures for a family wealth & venture group: ADGM vs DIFC vs RAK ICC vs mainland
items.question: Which structure should hold ventures, property and investments? Compare setup and annual costs, substance and audit requirements, Corporate Tax treatment (incl. qualifying free zone rules), eligibility to hold Dubai property, banking practicality, succession benefits and privacy. Cite the official authority pages.

result.summary: Hold venture shares in a light ADGM/DIFC holdco, keep Dubai rental property personal or in a separate SPV because rent is non-qualifying income that can strip a free zone company of 0% status, and confirm DLD eligibility before buying via any entity.

items.title: Dubai property purchase costs and rental yield data: what are current DLD fees, and where to get reliable yield data by community?
items.question: Verify current transfer, registration and trustee fees and mortgage registration costs with the Dubai Land Department; explain how to use the RERA rental index and DLD transaction data to estimate net yields by community. Update [[Property Investment Metrics]].

result.summary: A mortgaged Dubai resale purchase costs ~7% of price in non-financeable fees (DLD 2%+2%, agency 2%+VAT, trustee, 0.25% mortgage registration); build net yields from DLD transaction, Ejari, Smart Rental Index and Service Charge Index data.

items.title: UAE Corporate Tax essentials for a founder with several small ventures
items.question: Registration, thresholds and rates, small business relief, free zone treatment, record-keeping and filing deadlines, and how this applies to an individual starting businesses. Primary source: tax.gov.ae.

result.summary: 0% to AED 375k then 9%; Small Business Relief (revenue ≤ AED 3m) extended to periods ending 31 Dec 2029; sole traders taxable above AED 1m combined turnover; register in 3 months, file/pay in 9, keep records 7 years.

items.title: Due diligence: Wednesday Circuit
items.question: Market for C-suite golf networking and corporate golf events in the UAE: number and capacity of championship courses, corporate day pricing benchmarks, competitors and membership-based networking models, licensing needed to sell events, and the riskiest assumptions to test first.

result.summary: Demand backdrop is strong but peak tee-time access at premier courses and willingness to pay over sponsor-funded incumbents (CEO Masters, FORE Business) are the first things to test.

items.title: Due diligence: DCS Golf
items.question: Luxury hand-made leather/canvas golf bags: price points of premium competitors, materials and supplier options (UAE vs import), unit cost structure for small-batch production, DTC and pro-shop channels in the GCC, and licensing for a home-based start.

result.summary: Hand-made bags sell at USD 850–1,200, but a UAE full-leather bag leaves ~27% DTC margin and losses via retail, and the home licences are officially for UAE/GCC nationals — lead with canvas+leather trim and corporate gifting.

items.title: Due diligence: Al Ain Ostrich Farm
items.question: Ostrich farming economics (birds, feed, mortality, meat/leather/feather yields), South African industry benchmarks (Oudtshoorn), UAE permits for livestock farming, slaughter and food service (ADAFSA, MOCCAE), agri-tourism demand in Al Ain, and capital required for a greenfield site.

result.summary: ADAFSA farm rules do not name ostriches, the Farm Licence is for Emirati owners, SA bird imports were banned in 2019, and Ostrich Oasis already runs the model in Al Ain — resolve permission and supply first and reframe around the visitor experience.

items.title: Confirm DLD's current policy on company and foundation ownership of Dubai freehold (ADGM, DIFC, RAK ICC, mainland)
items.question: DLD policy is unpublished and secondary sources conflict (e.g. ADGM foundations reportedly excluded). Get written/official confirmation, required documents and fees on later share transfers. Informs whether any property should ever sit in an entity.

items.title: Net yields for 3–5 target Dubai communities from DLD open data
items.question: Pull 12 months of DLD sales and Ejari rents plus Service Charge Index figures for shortlisted communities and compute net yield on total cost, versus current investment mortgage rates (EIBOR + margin). Informs the first purchase decision.

items.title: UAE VAT essentials for the three ventures
items.question: Mandatory/voluntary registration thresholds, timing, zero-rating/exemptions relevant to golf goods, events and agri-tourism/food, and interaction with e-invoicing from 1 Jul 2027. Primary source: tax.gov.ae.

items.title: Abu Dhabi farm tenure and ostrich permissions for a non-national operator
items.question: Can an expat lease or partner on an Al Ain farm; does ADAFSA permit ratites; current MOCCAE status on South African ostriches/hatching eggs; abattoir and restaurant licensing. Gates the Al Ain Ostrich Farm.

items.title: Dubai home-based and e-commerce licence options for an expat resident maker
items.question: DET eligibility for eTrader/Intelaq for residents, whether licences permit crafting/manufacturing at home, and free zone e-commerce alternatives with official prices. Gates DCS Golf.
